en: A sepia-toned coastal landscape showing a beach on a rocky shoreline at sunset or sunrise. In the foreground there are plants and shrubs silhouetted against the light, with goats or sheep on a rough path. In the distance a distinctive sharp rock stack rises from the sea, with cliffs on the left framing a calm bay. Handwritten-style text in the lower left names the location, and a printed web address appears along the bottom right.
